name: Meditation
purpose: A channel-planning catalog of contemplative methods, philosophical sources, lived practice, secular adaptations, research, sound/media and access. Its Hindu textual core is complemented by explicitly attributed cross-tradition comparisons.

scope_routing.name: 278 Meditation
scope_routing.boundary: Primary home for contemplative attention, named meditation methods, japa, meditation experience and meditation-program research.

scope_routing.name: 279 Pranayama
scope_routing.boundary: Primary home for deliberate breath regulation, named pranayama techniques, traditional breath concepts, respiratory variables and protocol research.

scope_routing.name: 280 Yoga
scope_routing.boundary: Primary home for yoga philosophy, ethics, whole-system history, posture families, schools, sequencing and teaching systems.

TEXT.requirements: Inspect a named primary-text edition, passage locator, translator and commentary; compare attributions and keep spiritual or symbolic claims in their source context.
source_leads: IIT Kanpur Gita Supersite corpus (entry point listed in the batch guide)
the named work in a traceable edition
authorized public teaching materials for the tradition concerned

STUDY.requirements: Select actual study reports and registrations; extract intervention, population, comparator, outcomes, follow-up, adverse events, funding and limitations. Use current official guidance for clinical context.
source_leads: original journal reports and their supplementary protocols
NCCIH official guidance as orientation, not a substitute for original studies

COMMUNITY.requirements: Use a named community or program, authorized public documents and consented participant accounts; preserve differences of interpretation and do not generalize testimony into clinical evidence.
source_leads: the relevant institution's own curriculum and public policies
consented interviews with participants and qualified teachers
dated archival materials when making historical claims

HISTORY.requirements: Locate dated books, archival records, correspondence, photographs or institutional publications; distinguish contemporary evidence, later recollection and disputed chronology.
source_leads: the named author's dated original publications
independent scholarship used to test historical interpretation

DIGITAL.requirements: Inspect the named product version, dated terms, privacy policy and actual validation studies; distinguish engagement, measurement accuracy, benefit claims and financial incentives.
source_leads: the provider's product documentation and privacy policy
app change logs, funding disclosures and applicable official regulatory records

handoff: Retain the BANK ID in editorial notes. Name the exact case, edition, lineage, population, protocol or product version before promoting a broad question to an episode.

Inspect source passages and reports; add honest source-access records and a bounded idea through the existing registry workflow. Empty verified_sources lists mean this bank has not performed claim-level episode research.
Reuse an existing registered angle; confirm its current scope in ANGLE_PLAN.json. These catalog entries do not change Q1-Q42, CAT defaults, existing CONFIG snapshots or production gates.

If creating a formal depth plan, map the selected question to stable TOP IDs inside the niche Planning directory. Create a formal IDEA record only with its required evidence plan and readiness review; do not promote all proposals automatically.

Verify material claims in Phase 1 with exact locators. Attribute spiritual, historical and symbolic interpretations. Health outcomes require original evidence and current guidance; proposals do not supply personal medical advice.
Check neighboring banks for the same story question. Reuse the primary home and link the related topic; change the research question when a second niche needs its own episode.
Keep topic proposals, ready ideas, produced text packages and published videos as distinct statuses. Do not mark these proposals completed or trending based on their presence here.
coverage_limits: This first batch does not exhaust Buddhist schools, Hindu contemplative lineages, regional practices, women's histories, non-English primary sources, or disability-led accounts. Expand named traditions and source editions after case selection; no school's definition stands for meditation everywhere.
